description_en: Changes the specifications and storage space of a Hologres instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更实例的规格和存储空间
kebab_example: aliyun hologram scale-instance --instance-id hgprecn-cn-xxxxxxx --cpu 128 --storage-size 1000 --cold-storage-size 1000 --scale-type UPGRADE --gateway-count 4 --enable-serverless-computing true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScaleInstance

parameters.help_en:
The instance specifications. Valid values:

- `16`: 16 vCPUs and 64 GB of memory (1 compute node)

- `32`: 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (2 compute nodes)

- `64`: 64 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory (4 compute nodes)

- `96`: 96 vCPUs and 384 GB memory (6 compute nodes)

- `128`: 128 vCPUs and 512 GB memory (8 compute nodes)

- and so on.

> * Specify the number of vCPUs.
>
> * To purchase an instance type with more than 1024 vCPUs, submit a ticket.
>
> * Skip this parameter for shared instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。取值：
- 16核64 GB （计算节点数量：1）
- 32核128 GB（计算节点数量：2）
- 64核256 GB（计算节点数量：4）
- 96核384 GB（计算节点数量：6）
- 128核512 GB（计算节点数量：8）
- 等

>
 >- 填写核数即可。
 >- 购买1024以上规格请提交工单申请。
 >- Shared实例类型无需指定规格
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en:
The standard storage space of the instance. Unit: GB.

> This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例标准存储空间。单位：GB。

> 按量付费（PostPaid）实例会忽略此参数
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The cold storage space of the instance. Unit: GB.

> This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例低频存储空间。单位：GB。

> 按量付费（PostPaid）实例会忽略此参数
parameters.name: cold_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The scaling type.

- UPGRADE: Upgrades the instance.

- DOWNGRADE: Downgrades the instance.

> * **Upgrade an instance:** New specifications must be equal to or greater than original specifications. Leaving a parameter empty retains its original specification. At least one specification must be increased.
>
> * **Downgrade an instance:** New specifications must be equal to or less than original specifications. Leaving a parameter empty retains its original specification. At least one specification must be decreased
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型。取值：
- UPGRADE：升配
- DOWNGRADE：降配
> 
> - 升配规格不能小于原规格，为空的字段表示维持原规格不变，在此基础上，至少一项规格比原规格大。
> - 降配规格不能大于原规格，为空的字段表示维持原规格不变，在此基础上，至少一项规格比原规格小
parameters.name: scale_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of gateways. Valid values: \[2, 50].

> This parameter applies only to virtual warehouse instances
parameters.help_zh:
网关数量，取值[2, 50]。

> 只有Warehouse类型需要指定该参数
parameters.name: gateway_count

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Serverless Computing
parameters.name: enable_serverless_computing
